tiers.description: Low-latency tier for bounded research, mechanical checks, and structured synthesis.
selection_criteria: The task is narrow and evidence can be checked directly.
The work follows an existing pattern without design decisions.

tiers.description: General-purpose tier for ordinary implementation, integration, and review work.
selection_criteria: The task has a clear contract but requires normal engineering judgment.
The task changes one subsystem or performs a focused cross-file review.

tiers.description: High-reasoning tier for subtle correctness, security, and cross-cutting analysis.
selection_criteria: The task has subtle invariants, security implications, or broad blast radius.
A cheaper tier has failed validation and the diagnosis requires deeper reasoning.
